summary: Feed s082_single to NDR is degraded: 3.9% TCP packet loss detected (73/1886 packets) exceeds 1% threshold. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, truncation, VLAN, encryption, tunnels, oversize, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN/mirror source is dropping packets under load - TCP sequence gaps indicate buffer overrun / oversubscription before the NDR. SPAN/mirror ports drop under burst and single 10G tool port with no load-balancing cannot sustain peak aggregate rate, causing random loss across flows.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires both directions and full payload for TCP reassembly and detection. 3.87% missing data breaks stream reassembly, causes incomplete flows, missed signatures/anomalies, and reduced detection coverage with false negatives.

params.replacement: passive TAP with packet broker buffering

recommended_fix.why: TAP provides lossless, out-of-band copy without SPAN buffer drops; combined with proper broker capacity/load-balancing it eliminates the 3.9% loss and restores complete TCP streams the NDR needs.
